newsitem.title: USA: Cobb County, Ga., to buy land for hockey arena.
newsitem.headline: Cobb County, Ga., to buy land for hockey arena.

text.p: Georgia's Cobb-Marietta Coliseum and Exhibit Authority has agreed to issue $22.3 million of revenue bonds to buy land for a hockey arena and expand its convention center, the Atlanta Journal-Constitution said Thursday.
Bond proceeds will finance the purchase of 11.5 acres of land near the Cobb Galleria Centre mall.

If Atlanta suceeds in attracting a major-league hockey team, plans call for building a 20,000-seat arena costing about $150 milion. If it is unable to attract a hockey team, the authority will consider using the land for a performing arts center or amphitheater, the newspaper said.
Some of the bond proceeds will also be used to buy the Galleria, part of which is to be used to double the size of the Cobb County Convention Center.
